name: The Ironmark Stockade
override: John, 2026-11-11: hand-drawn castle layout (no Watabou); Veterans Day story: the war has just ended, warlord Gharrek refuses the peace and holds Crown prisoners.
wall_text: The grey stone bands around the floor are the tops of thick castle walls and the dark area is solid ground outside the building: keep them exactly as they are; do not move, redraw or extend any wall.
prompt_style: Objects are modeled 3D assets from a modern dark-fantasy video game (Unreal Engine 5), seen from directly above, each casting a soft dark contact shadow onto the floor. A hobgoblin war fortress on the night the war ended, still fully manned: iron-banded crates, weapon racks, spears, round shields, red-and-black war banners, braziers, barrels, sacks, straw, chains, rough timber furniture, maps and ledgers, bones. Use many small objects (a dozen or more) rather than a few large ones; nothing larger than the sizes given. Furniture stands against the walls; the middle of the room stays mostly open.

3.name: Gatehouse
